name: ZapFast v0.21.0
body:
ZapFast 0.21.0 adds chat export, link previews on the messages you send, contact blocking, disappearing-message controls, progress and cancel for attachments, and full-size review before sending. Screen readers and the keyboard can move through messages, voice messages you have not heard are marked, downloads sort into folders, and the Linux packages install on Debian 12 again. It also fixes a crash when sound plays on some Linux systems, a link that stayed down until a restart, an update that could stop ZapFast from starting, videos that never arrived, edits and stars that went missing, and stickers that stayed blank.

**Download ZapFast:** [Mac](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-v0.21.0-macos-universal.dmg) · [Windows](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-v0.21.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.msi) · [Windows ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-v0.21.0-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.msi) · [Linux](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-v0.21.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Linux ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-v0.21.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [AppImage](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-0.21.0-x86_64.AppImage) · [AppImage ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-0.21.0-aarch64.AppImage) · [Flatpak](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-v0.21.0-x86_64.flatpak) · [Debian/Ubuntu](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast_0.21.0_amd64.deb) · [Fedora](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-0.21.0-1.x86_64.rpm)

On a Mac, `brew install --cask crmne/tap/zapfast`. On Arch, `yay -S zapfast-bin`.

![A chat with a link preview card above the message field and on a sent message](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-0.21.0-link-preview.png)

![A staged picture shown large in the chat pane, with a caption field and a strip of tiles](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-0.21.0-review-attachments.png)

![The Export chat dialog with an option to include attachments](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.21.0/zapfast-0.21.0-export-chat.png)

*The screenshots use ZapFast's built-in demo content.*

## New

- **Screen readers and the keyboard can move through messages.** Alt+2 (Control+2 on a Mac) goes to the message list, and the arrows, Home, End, Page Up and Page Down move through it. Each message is read as one item, with its sender, text and time. By @a2hsh. (#504, #434)
- **Voice messages you have not heard yet show a dot** beside their length, until you play them here or on another device. By @bruno-costanzo. (#538)
- **Downloads are sorted into folders** inside the download folder you chose: one for each account, named by its number, and one for each chat, named after it. By @eternalwaitt. (#616)
- **Clear chat is in the chat list's right-click menu.** By @bogusyogi; thanks @Raposoraptor. (#607, #557)
- **Mute is one submenu** in the chat list's right-click menu, with 8 hours, 1 week and Always. By @crmne.
- **You can write in a locked chat once it is open,** instead of only reading it. By @jeffersongoncalves. (#610)
- **New installs follow the system's light or dark mode.** A theme you already chose stays. By @bogusyogi; thanks @manuelmeurer. (#611, #551)
- **The Linux packages install on Debian 12 again,** and on Ubuntu 22.10 and Fedora 37 and newer. By @crmne; thanks @UllashMishra. (#600)
- **Links you send carry a preview,** made on your own machine, with nothing in between. Turning previews off on your phone turns them off here. By @chiefdfo. (#763, #567)
- **Block and unblock contacts,** and see who is blocked. By @ArthurWillers. (#625)
- **Turn disappearing messages on or off** and change the timer, in one-to-one chats and groups. By @fgrehm. (#531, #191)
- **See how far an attachment has got, and cancel one going out.** By @joaodutra88. (#511, #411)
- **Animated Lottie stickers play.** By @danielfeelz-backup. (#615)
- **Edit a group's description** from its info panel. By @crmne. (#629)
- **Look at a contact's profile picture full size.** By @crmne. (#640)
- **Keep the voice message controls in view** after switching chats. By @crmne. (#602)
- **The sticker picker stays open after sending a sticker.** By @crmne. (#635)
- **Photos sent in a row show as one album.** By @crmne. (#733)
- **The tray icon shows your unread count,** and on Linux and Windows follows the panel's light or dark style. By @crmne. (#375, #518)
- **Notifications name the account** when several are linked. By @crmne. (#731)
- **Scroll the wheel over your picture to switch accounts.** By @crmne. (#739)
- **Export a chat** from its menu, as text with or without its attachments. By @eternalwaitt. (#664)
- **Review attachments at full size before sending,** with a caption and a way to add or remove files. By @simonbbby. (#752, #698)
- **Reactions take less room:** a few on the bubble, and a click shows who reacted with what. By @simonbbby. (#760, #450, #561)
- **Bold, italic, strikethrough and monospace are in the message field's right-click menu.** By @simonbbby; thanks @Raposoraptor. (#762, #575)
- **The GIF picker loads more as you scroll, and its results animate.** By @simonbbby and @ayoubdya. (#759, #514, #623, #513)
- **Forward sits beside every message,** with React and Reply. By @edsonboldrini. (#700)
- **A Home Manager module** declares settings on NixOS. By @augustocdias. (#637)
- **Reach a message's actions from the keyboard.** Shift+F10 opens the current message's menu, and single keys reply, react, copy, forward and more. By @a2hsh. (#634)
- **Mute one account's notifications** from the account switcher. By @rodolfomichetti. (#628)
- **Paste as plain text with Ctrl+Shift+V** also from a clipboard that holds a picture, such as cells copied from a spreadsheet. By @simonbbby; thanks @DaveMcGlashan. (#738, #711)
- **New chat finds people by the start of each word,** so "j d" finds John Doe. By @Mayank-Bhatasana. (#767)
- **Forwarding your own message no longer marks it as forwarded,** as on the phone. By @crmne; thanks @Raposoraptor. (#554)
- **Someone recording a voice message shows as recording,** not typing. By @eternalwaitt. (#726)
- **Group call history says how many people were on the call.** By @alitura1. (#735)
- **Cameras that only offer YU12, such as Iriun Webcam, work on Linux.** By @demostenex. (#720)
- **French phone numbers are grouped in pairs.** By @AlexandreAgrn. (#632)

## Fixed

- **ZapFast no longer gets killed when sound plays on some Linux systems.** With no real-time budget left, it now asks for a raised priority instead. By @simonbbby, in fastframe; thanks @sanotsroger. (#677)
- **A connection that lost its socket reconnects by itself,** instead of refusing to send until a restart. By @OmarGonD. (#764, #724)
- **An update no longer stops ZapFast from starting** when an older copy left files beside your linked account. They stay where they are, and your account starts. By @crmne. (#620)
- **Videos in formats other than MP4, such as a `.mov`, arrive.** They used to go out as video messages WhatsApp never delivered; they now go as documents, as the original file. By @crmne; thanks @Raposoraptor. (#553)
- **A message edited before you linked ZapFast shows up after history sync,** with its edit, instead of missing entirely. By @crmne; thanks @NomaDigitalAds, who traced it. (#582)
- **Messages you starred before 0.20 show up in Starred.** ZapFast fetches your stars from WhatsApp once more. By @crmne; thanks @itszux. (#604)
- **Your phone marks a voice message you played here as heard,** also with read receipts off in your privacy settings, as the phone does. By @crmne; thanks @itszux. (#501)
- **Messages to a broadcast list stay in the contact's chat,** and ones already filed under "Unknown" move there. By @victorblino. (#753, #537)
- **The chat filter row has no scroll bar lying over its chips.** The wheel and touchpad still scroll it. By @crmne; thanks @Raposoraptor. (#642)
- **Pasting pictures with Ctrl+V works on Wayland and in the Flatpak.** By @simonbbby. (#695, #687)
- **Holding a letter on a Mac shows the accent picker.** By @merlinkraemer. (#262)
- **Hebrew sentences wrap in reading order,** and the caret stays beside mixed text. By @GruperTal. (#496)
- **Parts of the window no longer draw over the chat list** after reopening from the tray. By @crmne. (#638)
- **Profile pictures on disk show while a newer one is fetched,** instead of initials. By @crmne. (#661)
- **You can reply to view-once messages.** By @crmne. (#563)
- **A missing file says so** and offers Download, instead of opening a folder. By @eternalwaitt. (#617, #662)
- **Fetching older history wakes your phone far less often.** By @crmne. (#737)
- **ZapFast takes focus when it opens.** By @crmne. (#755)
- **Clicking the Windows tray icon hides a window that is in front.** By @crmne. (#541)
- **With Keep running in background off, no tray item appears.** By @crmne. (#457)
- **Full phone numbers show wherever ZapFast knows them.** Numbers WhatsApp hides still show dots. By @crmne. (#627, #408)
- **Idle macOS windows use less GPU.** By @ezariago. (#768)
- **Header buttons no longer overlap the name or the window controls, and panel dividers line up.** By @crmne. (#622, #626, #639)
- **Button labels in right-to-left languages read in order.** By @3bdullah-CYS. (#757)
- **Typing in the chat search no longer slows the window.** By @edsonboldrini. (#701)
- **Connection notices sit below the chat header on every platform,** so the chat list stays put. By @simonbbby. (#761, #309)
- **The media viewer shows downloaded pictures in its strip when the message had no thumbnail,** and a click beside the picture closes it. By @simonbbby and @edsonboldrini. (#751, #736, #699)
- **A sticker whose file holds a single animation frame shows up.** By @Goodly58. (#702)
- **Attachments go out in the order you staged them.** By @thize. (#747)
- **The linking screen keeps asking for new QR codes** instead of stopping. By @hikari-work. (#756)
- **Paused audio no longer keeps Windows awake.** By @simonbbby. (#750, #732)
- **An archive change that WhatsApp did not accept leaves the chat in place.** Archiving now needs a connection. By @marijnbent. (#708)
- **Selecting text in long chats stays steady and responsive.** By @eternalwaitt. (#719)
- **Replies to an album show their quote once.** By @simonbbby. (#715, #681)
- **Text starting with `>` and no space stays as typed,** so `>.<` is not a quote. By @simonbbby. (#730, #722)
- **The emoji picker closes when you send text.** By @simonbbby. (#652, #613)
- **Media viewer thumbnails fill their tiles, and its arrows stay at the window's edges.** By @simonbbby. (#659, #608, #758, #605)
- **More tooltips and titles are translated.** By @crmne. (#555)
- **Stickers no longer stay blank.** One whose file has gone missing downloads again, and one that cannot be shown offers "click to retry". By @crmne; thanks @itszux. (#603)
- **Ctrl+End moves the cursor to the end of what you are typing,** and jumps to the newest message only from an empty composer. By @crmne; thanks @KeronCyst. (#456)
- **One chat that never answers no longer holds up older history for the others.** By @eternalwaitt. (#612)
- **A download is reported as saved only once ZapFast has recorded it,** so it is not forgotten after a restart. By @eternalwaitt. (#618)

## Changed

- **On Windows, the installer is now the `.msi`.** The older setup program (`-setup.exe`) is gone. ZapFast 0.20.0 and later move over by themselves when they update. If you have 0.19 or older, its updater won't find this release: download the `.msi` once and run it. It installs over your copy, and your chats and settings stay.

## Known limitations

- About 200 of the interface's words are new or newly translatable and still show in English in other languages. [Translations are welcome](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/issues/new?template=translation.yml).
- Calls are still a work in progress, as described in [0.20.0](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/tag/v0.20.0): video calls are in alpha, and in group calls your video stops for a moment every few seconds (#592).

## Thanks

@a2hsh, @bruno-costanzo, @eternalwaitt, @bogusyogi, @jeffersongoncalves, @simonbbby, @OmarGonD, @rodolfomichetti, @AlexandreAgrn, @Mayank-Bhatasana, @alitura1, @demostenex, @Goodly58, @thize, @hikari-work, @marijnbent, @ayoubdya, @edsonboldrini, @victorblino, @augustocdias, @chiefdfo, @ArthurWillers, @fgrehm, @joaodutra88, @danielfeelz-backup, @GruperTal, @merlinkraemer, @ezariago, @3bdullah-CYS and @Yoryoboy for the pull requests in this release, and @Raposoraptor, @NomaDigitalAds, @itszux, @KeronCyst, @manuelmeurer, @UllashMishra, @DaveMcGlashan and @sanotsroger for their reports.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/compare/v0.20.1...v0.21.0

name: ZapFast v0.20.1
body:
ZapFast 0.20.1 fixes custom themes with see-through colours on Linux, which 0.20.0 broke, and brings the first round of contributions since: send a photo as view once, group status mentions no longer show as unsupported messages, HD copies of photos stay out of the chat, and about 140 more of the interface's words can be translated.

**Download ZapFast:** [Mac](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.1/zapfast-v0.20.1-macos-universal.dmg) · [Windows](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.1/zapfast-v0.20.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.msi) · [Windows ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.1/zapfast-v0.20.1-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.msi) · [Linux](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.1/zapfast-v0.20.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Linux ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.1/zapfast-v0.20.1-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [AppImage](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.1/zapfast-0.20.1-x86_64.AppImage) · [AppImage ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.1/zapfast-0.20.1-aarch64.AppImage) · [Flatpak](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.1/zapfast-v0.20.1-x86_64.flatpak) · [Debian/Ubuntu](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.1/zapfast_0.20.1_amd64.deb) · [Fedora](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.1/zapfast-0.20.1-1.x86_64.rpm)

On a Mac, `brew install --cask crmne/tap/zapfast`. On Arch, `yay -S zapfast-bin`.

## New

- **Send a photo as view once.** By @ArthurWillers. (#597)
- **ZapFast leaves notifications to your phone while your displays are off,** so they don't wait unseen on a sleeping computer. By @victorblino. (#596)
- **About 140 more of the interface's words can be translated:** menus, dialogs and labels that were English in every language. By @brsbrkctn. (#516)

## Fixed

- **Custom themes with see-through colours work on Linux again.** Since 0.20.0 such a theme was drawn on an opaque window, so scrolling left trails and an unfocused window flickered. It gets a transparent window again, as in 0.19, and blur from the compositor works as before. By @crmne; thanks @Marukooh, who traced it. (#593)
- **"Mentioned this group in their status" no longer shows as an unsupported message.** The phone shows no message for it, and neither does ZapFast now; the ones already filed are removed. By @crmne; thanks @sonthomsen, who decoded it. (#595)
- **The HD copy of a photo or video no longer shows as an unsupported message** next to the photo itself. By @sonthomsen. (#594)
- **Stars, pins and motion photos survive** when a contact's privacy-id chat and phone-number chat are merged. By @samirhvbr. (#590)
- **Voice messages with a repeated first page play** instead of being refused. By @bruno-costanzo. (#571)
- **Pinned chats stay above chats with a parked draft,** and the composer's Undo stays within the chat and account it was typed in. By @eternalwaitt. (#533, #529)
- **The forward dialog uses the room a large window gives it,** and group delivery ticks are looked up faster. By @Dug0412. (#546, #547)
- A cryptography library used for calls and media takes a security update (RUSTSEC-2026-0385). By @crmne.

## Known limitations

- Calls are still a work in progress, as described in [0.20.0](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/tag/v0.20.0): video calls are in alpha, and in group calls your video stops for a moment every few seconds (#592).

## Thanks

@ArthurWillers, @victorblino, @brsbrkctn, @sonthomsen, @samirhvbr, @bruno-costanzo, @eternalwaitt and @Dug0412 for the pull requests in this release, and @Marukooh and @sonthomsen for their reports.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/compare/v0.20.0...v0.20.1

name: ZapFast v0.20.0
body:
ZapFast 0.20.0 makes and answers WhatsApp calls: voice and video, one-to-one and, as an experiment, in groups. It rings for an incoming call, and a new Calls page lists every call. Calls are new and video calls are in alpha, so please try them, and if something breaks, point your agents at it: pull requests are very welcome. A rail beside the chat list now holds Chats, Calls, Starred and Settings. Sound and recording run on a new audio layer that talks to PipeWire directly on Linux. This release also brings group invite links and group management, starred and pinned messages, a full-window photo and video viewer, chat info in a side panel, sound in WhatsApp's videos, deletions that sync with your phone, and dozens of fixes from more than forty contributors. The prebuilt Linux packages need Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13 or newer: Ubuntu 22.04 and Debian 12 are not supported.

**Download ZapFast:** [Mac](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.0/zapfast-v0.20.0-macos-universal.dmg) · [Windows](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.0/zapfast-v0.20.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.msi) · [Windows ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.0/zapfast-v0.20.0-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.msi) · [Linux](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.0/zapfast-v0.20.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Linux ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.0/zapfast-v0.20.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [AppImage](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.0/zapfast-0.20.0-x86_64.AppImage) · [AppImage ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.0/zapfast-0.20.0-aarch64.AppImage) · [Flatpak](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.0/zapfast-v0.20.0-x86_64.flatpak) · [Debian/Ubuntu](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.0/zapfast_0.20.0_amd64.deb) · [Fedora](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.0/zapfast-0.20.0-1.x86_64.rpm)

On a Mac, `brew install --cask crmne/tap/zapfast`. On Arch, `yay -S zapfast-bin`.

On Windows, pick the `.msi`. The setup program (`-setup.exe`) is still attached so that installs from 0.19.0 and earlier can update through it.

![The Calls page in the rail beside the chat list, with recent and missed calls, the All and Missed chips, and a call-back button on each row](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.20.0/zapfast-0.20.0-calls.png)

*The screenshot uses ZapFast's built-in demo content.*

## New

- **Voice calls.** The phone button in a chat's header calls that person, and an incoming call takes over the window with Accept and Decline, raises a notification and rings, even with the window in the tray. You hear a ringback tone while their phone rings. During a call you can mute, switch the microphone or speaker, and put the call screen aside to keep chatting while it runs. A muted, archived or locked chat's call stays as quiet as its messages. By @crmne, building on the work of @alitura1. (#220)
- **Video calls, in alpha.** The camera button starts a video call, turns your camera off and on, or switches a voice call to video from either side. A computer without a camera still takes part and sees the other side. Your picture goes out at 25 frames a second, up to 720p, and follows the connection: it steps down rather than stalling when the other side receives less. Each picture is sent with repair packets, as WhatsApp's own apps send them, so a lost packet is rebuilt on the other side instead of freezing the picture until the next full one. An iPhone relies on them, and with them calls to an iPhone that froze every few seconds ran smooth in testing. If a call misbehaves, please attach your log to an issue: it counts why frames drop, never what was said or shown. **Settings > Files > Log > Open** shows it, and the [guide](https://zapfast.rocks/settings-and-files/#the-log) says where it lives. By @crmne, building on the work of @alitura1, with the repair packets and pacing contributed to whatsapp-rust. (#255)
- **Group calls, as an experiment.** A group's header has the call buttons a person's has, a call to one of your groups rings here, and a call link in a message joins its call. Everyone hears everyone and each person gets a tile, but in testing your own video, as the others see it, still stopped for a moment every few seconds. By @crmne, building on the work of @alitura1. (#395)
- **Calls take the speaker's echo out of your microphone,** so the other side does not hear themselves when you call without headphones, all in Rust with WebRTC's echo canceller, noise suppression and gain control. By @crmne.
- **A Calls page and call history.** Every call takes its place in its chat, as on the phone: voice or video, who called, how long it lasted, or that it was missed or declined. Calls in the rail lists them newest first, with All and Missed chips, a search, and a call-back button on each row. New call offers the people you call most, then every contact. By @crmne, building on the work of @alitura1. (#256)
- **A navigation rail beside the chat list.** Chats and Calls sit at the top, and Starred, Archived, Locked chats, Settings and your own photo (the account switcher) at the bottom, on every platform. With the chat list hidden, your chats' pictures fill the rail. Ctrl+Shift+1 goes to Chats and Ctrl+Shift+2 to Calls (Command on a Mac). By @crmne.
- **ZapFast's sound talks to PipeWire directly on Linux,** else PulseAudio, else ALSA, on a new audio layer shared by voice messages, videos, call tones and notification sounds. It follows the default device when it changes and reopens it after a failure. ZapFast shows up as "ZapFast" in your volume mixer, and a call is marked as a call, so the system can lower other sound while it runs. By @crmne.
- **Star messages and find them again** under Starred in the rail. By @LisandroNahuelH. (#236)
- **Pin a message in a chat for everyone,** and see what others pinned. By @LisandroNahuelH. (#234)
- **A full-window viewer for photos and videos,** with the chat's album to move through and the message's actions at hand. The arrow keys and buttons step through a chat's photos. By @LisandroNahuelH (#189) and @8bury; thanks @edmooredop. (#436, #308)
- **Chat info opens in a side panel** beside the conversation, with the chat's media, links and documents. It also shows a group's description and a chat's disappearing-message timer. By @pulgueta (#264), @nalyx1 (#391, #389) and @fgrehm. (#424, #191)
- **Delete for me syncs with your phone and your other devices,** both ways, and a deletion made while offline goes out once ZapFast reconnects. By @eternalwaitt; thanks @AbdullahHouso. (#384, #393)
- **Select messages with check boxes,** as in WhatsApp Web, from Select messages in the chat's menu. Copy them with Cmd or Ctrl+C, forward them, or delete them all at once. By @rafaelsantana6 (#300), @moleh1307 (#409; thanks @itszux, #326) and @eternalwaitt. (#321)
- **Forward to several chats at once,** and check the list before it is sent. By @eternalwaitt. (#336)
- **Reply privately** to a group message in the sender's own chat, with the message quoted. By @eternalwaitt. (#359)
- **Photos and videos sent together show as an album,** with Download all and Save all. By @eternalwaitt. (#286)
- **Crop and rotate a picture before sending it,** by clicking it in the attachment strip. By @Rokuko-L. (#453)
- **Send pictures as documents,** from a file or the clipboard, so they arrive uncompressed. By @FelipeFMedeiros; thanks @rajarshikhatua. (#469, #362)
- **Send a location** from coordinates or a map link. By @fabiomotta0311. (#301)
- **Create a group** from New chat: pick the people, name it, and add a photo if you like. By @crmne.
- **Manage a group from its info:** copy its invite link to share or reset it, add members, make or dismiss admins, remove someone, and set who may edit the group, send messages and add members, and whether admins approve new members. By @crmne.
- **`whatsapp://` group invite links open in ZapFast.** By @paixaomp. (#591)
- **Message a number you have not saved.** By @eternalwaitt. (#320)
- **Mention everyone in a group with @all,** or the word for it in your language. By @rafaelsantana6. (#418)
- **Chats that mention you are marked with "@"** in the list, and open at the mention. By @crmne; thanks @jamorenom. (#487)
- **Sound in WhatsApp's videos.** Every video WhatsApp sends played silently; now its sound plays with it. By @claudiocp; thanks @joaogks. (#462, #265)
- **Play videos at 1.5x and 2x,** like voice messages. By @claudiocp. (#465, #464)
- **A chat can keep its own voice message speed,** from "Voice message speed" in its menu. By @bruno-costanzo. (#526)
- **Motion photos play** instead of showing their clip as an unsupported message. By @Z1xus. (#399)
- **Audio files look different from voice messages,** with a seek bar and a music icon. By @eternalwaitt. (#365, #361)
- **Phone numbers in messages are links.** By @nathanbzrr. (#303)
- **Open a chat from outside ZapFast:** `zapfast` followed by a number, a `wa.me` link, a `whatsapp://` link or a group invite link opens that chat or the invite, and the desktop can hand `whatsapp:` links to ZapFast. By @assawalhy (#426; #407) and @tassiovirginio. (#479)
- **ZapFast fits a narrow window,** showing the chat list or one chat at a time, with a back arrow between them. By @frantgn90. (#356)
- **The day stays at the top of a chat while you scroll,** and older day labels carry their date. By @eternalwaitt. (#319)
- **The window comes back at the same size, place and zoom.** By @jbouhier, with the size kept in logical pixels by @crmne. (#385)
- **The chat list filter is remembered** across restarts. By @crmne; thanks @BurrHM. (#380)
- **A short chat sits at the bottom of the view,** next to the composer, as in WhatsApp Web. By @crmne; thanks @BurrHM. (#378)
- **A reaction to your message moves its chat up the list,** as on WhatsApp. By @crmne; thanks @BurrHM. (#373)
- **Hide message content in notifications.** Turn off "Show message content in notifications" in Settings, and every notification says only "New message". By @crmne; thanks @BurrHM. (#376)
- **Limit repeat notifications** from busy direct chats, groups, or both: one notification, then quiet for 10 minutes or until you read it. A mention or a reply to you still notifies. By @TopShaggerGomlen. (#406)
- **Keep chats archived, or not.** Turn off "Keep chats archived" in Settings, and a new message brings its chat back from the archive, as on the phone. By @caumeira; thanks @MatharuG. (#390, #208)
- **Keep the chat list where it is after sending,** as an option. By @eternalwaitt. (#366)
- **Documents keep their own names** in a download folder you chose. By @crmne; thanks @rajarshikhatua. (#363)
- **Large attachments download when you click them,** whatever their size. Only automatic downloads keep the 64 MiB limit. By @crmne; thanks @dCo3lh0 and @8bury. (#386, #316)
- **Older history and its files download in the background,** when you turn it on in Settings. By @LisandroNahuelH. (#194)
- **Settings shows how much space downloaded attachments take,** and can clear them. By @LisandroNahuelH. (#232)
- **Reload earlier messages** from a message's menu asks the phone again for the messages before it, to fill a gap without relinking. Edited replies and the phone's own order are kept in history. By @crmne.
- **Click a message's time or ticks to open Message info.** By @UMCEKO. (#414)
- **A clicked sticker opens on its own,** with Add to favorites. By @treepo1. (#268)
- **A Messages theme,** with bubbles shaped and coloured as Messages draws them on the Mac. By @iclems (#332, #331), with the bubble shapes by @crmne.
- **A drawn title bar on Windows and Linux,** as an option under Settings > Appearance > Custom title bar. By @crmne.
- **New shortcuts:** Ctrl+E archives the open chat, Ctrl+Shift+A switches to the next linked number (Command on a Mac), and the mouse's side buttons go back and forth. By @GeorgeMunas (#427, #428) and @Nullpntr1337. (#401)
- **Screen readers hear status changes** such as toasts, errors and a dropped connection, and NVDA no longer freezes while someone is typing. By @a2hsh. (#480, #434, #438)
- **The macOS Dock icon shows your unread chats.** By @crmne; thanks @joseddg92 and @traerin. (#368, #346)
- **Clicking a macOS notification opens its chat.** By @victorcesc. (#472)
- **Linux desktops treat ZapFast's notifications as chat:** they appear in KDE's notification settings, play the system message sound, carry the instant-message category, and mark ZapFast in the taskbar. The launcher gains a Quit ZapFast action. By @pataar. (#415, #416, #417, #419, #420)
- **A phone camera can open Linked devices from the pairing QR code.** By @bruno-costanzo. (#471)
- **Your computer's name shows in the phone's Linked devices** after you link again. By @fgrehm. (#448, #210)
- **Indonesian.** By @yasfaa. (#402)
- **Message summaries such as "Photo" are in your language** in the chat list, quotes and notifications. By @bruno-costanzo. (#527)
- **Shift+Insert pastes text,** as in other Linux applications, so espanso's longer expansions arrive on Wayland. By @alejogtz. (#576)
- **A Windows Installer (.msi) package,** for x64 and ARM. It takes over an earlier install, keeping your chats and settings. By @crmne.
- **The Nix package builds on Apple Silicon Macs.** By @surma. (#306)

## Fixed

- **Voice messages keep their first moment.** A USB microphone that the system put to sleep takes a moment to wake, and what you said meanwhile was lost; the time now starts when the microphone delivers sound. By @crmne.
- **Recording carries on through a microphone hiccup.** By @karadoganyi; thanks @oovaa. (#481, #382)
- **No more endless audio errors on Linux** after a sound device underrun, which held a CPU core until restart. By @crmne; thanks @survey-sudo. (#507)
- **The account shows offline while ZapFast sits in the tray,** so your phone gets its notifications. By @udaya2899; thanks @Clascheurduturfu. (#475, #461)
- **A message sent while reconnecting goes back to the composer** instead of failing for good. By @crmne; thanks @oovaa. (#452)
- **Stickers send again** when the picker opens, instead of hitting WhatsApp's rate limit. By @claudiocp and @crmne; thanks @claudiocp. (#468, #405)
- **"Follow system" follows the light or dark preference** of GNOME, KDE and other Linux desktops. By @crmne; thanks @dkess. (#483)
- **GNOME on Wayland draws a proper window frame** instead of a square grey one. By @crmne; thanks @pratyush-1327. (#397)
- **The Flatpak shows desktop notifications.** By @crmne; thanks @jamorenom. (#510)
- **On GNOME a notified message no longer also shows "ZapFast is ready".** By @claudiocp. (#467, #466)
- **Clicked links no longer leave defunct browser processes behind** on Linux. By @crmne; thanks @akitaonrails. (#446)
- **A hidden start at login stays hidden on GNOME,** waiting for the tray instead of opening the window. By @crmne; thanks @pedronora. (#429)
- **Built-in notification sounds respect Do Not Disturb and Focus** on a Mac. By @crmne; thanks @lucasew. (#211)
- **Pasting an image with a quick Ctrl+V tap works,** and pasted attachments stay in the chat they were pasted in. By @eternalwaitt; thanks @devrimyz. (#317, #494, #340)
- **Phone numbers are grouped by their own country code.** By @karadoganyi; thanks @tizoras. (#476, #449)
- **The app icon shows in Qt trays and launchers.** By @karadoganyi; thanks @paganotoni. (#482, #396)
- **Read ticks stay grey when your read receipts are off,** as on the phone. By @fgrehm. (#458)
- **A message the contact never read no longer turns blue** or claims a read time of 1969. By @dhanyel. (#370, #369)
- **A group created on the phone shows at once.** By @boskowski. (#400)
- **Chats split between a phone number and a privacy id come back together** once WhatsApp links the two. By @nathanbzrr. (#423)
- **Followed channels show their names,** and empty ones you no longer follow are gone. By @LILQK. (#525)
- **A live location says when its newer positions are only on the phone,** instead of showing a pin that never moves. By @fabiomotta0311. (#302)
- **Edits are checked before they are sent,** and a failed edit keeps the original. The cursor starts at the end of the text. By @eternalwaitt (#337) and @ridvansevik; thanks @Halliday202. (#485, #456)
- **A changed chat picture shows at once,** without a restart. By @crmne.
- **A chat opens at its end** without flashing its oldest messages first. By @frantgn90. (#357)
- **Message text is easier to select,** from anywhere in the bubble. By @eternalwaitt. (#281)
- **ZapFast reconnects right after your computer wakes** on Linux and Windows, instead of waiting for the link to time out. By @crmne.
- **Closing a minimized window keeps ZapFast in the tray,** and on niri a notification or a second launch brings the existing window forward. By @crmne and @tassiovirginio. (#474)
- **Settings survive a crash or power cut,** and saving them no longer freezes the window under disk load. By @crmne.
- **A 12-hour clock on GNOME is followed inside the Flatpak.** By @crmne.
- **A voice message's time sits on its duration line.** By @bruno-costanzo. (#473)
- **The chip rows show their scroll bar below the chips,** and long titles and submenus fit their space. By @n3ndor (#422), @iclems (#470), @vncsalencar (#435) and @frantgn90. (#372)
- **Removing a sticker pack asks first.** By @tobymarks. (#207)
- **macOS shows ZapFast's notifications,** which it had refused because they went out under a different identity from the app's. By @Bervinm. (#577)
- **A new message no longer brings ZapFast forward on Hyprland,** for example out of a scratchpad. By @boskowski; thanks @Yoryoboy. (#562, #530)
- **Every entry of the message menu is translated,** not only Open in system player. By @karadoganyi; thanks @Raposoraptor. (#565, #552)
- **Archiving or unarchiving a chat here reaches your phone,** and ZapFast follows the phone's Keep chats archived setting. By @thize. (#589, #572)
- **People you never wrote to stay out of the chat list.** By @thize. (#573)
- **Your sent messages sit at the time WhatsApp's server gave them,** so a reply that arrives after them no longer appears above them. By @thize; thanks @CorgiLeo. (#574, #548)
- **The log of a run that froze survives the restart,** as `zapfast.previous.log` beside the new one, so it can still be attached to an issue. By @crmne; thanks @Isllanrx. (#560)
- **A download that timed out leaves no partial file behind.** By @akitaonrails. (#580, #579)
- **The Nix package no longer pulls in the compiler** (about 280 MiB) at run time. By @crmne; thanks @v1cferr. (#498)

## Known limitations

- **Calls are a work in progress.** On a connection that loses many packets at once, the other side's picture can still stop for about a second until a fresh one arrives: the repair packets rebuild a few lost packets at a time, not a burst of ten or more. Sound and picture now carry the timing a phone needs to line them up, but they can still drift apart. In group calls your video stops for a moment every few seconds, since only one-to-one calls send repair packets yet. Please attach your log to an issue when a call misbehaves, and pull requests are very welcome: the call code is in `src/calls.rs` and in whatsapp-rust's `voip` module.
- The prebuilt Linux packages (tarball, AppImage, `.deb` and `.rpm`) need glibc 2.39: Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, Fedora 40 or newer. They do not run on Ubuntu 22.04 or Debian 12.
- Building ZapFast on Linux now needs libpipewire's headers and clang.
- On Windows a file pasted with Ctrl+V can still attach nothing for some people (#404). The log now says where it stopped; please attach it to that issue.

## Thanks

@alitura1, whose calling pull requests this release's calls grew from, and @eternalwaitt, @LisandroNahuelH, @claudiocp, @bruno-costanzo, @fabiomotta0311, @pataar, @fgrehm, @karadoganyi, @frantgn90, @rafaelsantana6, @nathanbzrr, @a2hsh, @GeorgeMunas, @iclems, @tassiovirginio, @8bury, @jbouhier, @caumeira, @dhanyel, @surma, @yasfaa, @Z1xus, @UMCEKO, @assawalhy, @Nullpntr1337, @victorcesc, @udaya2899, @ridvansevik, @boskowski, @n3ndor, @moleh1307, @TopShaggerGomlen, @tobymarks, @FelipeFMedeiros, @Rokuko-L, @treepo1, @pulgueta, @nalyx1, @vncsalencar, @LILQK, @alejogtz, @Bervinm, @akitaonrails, @thize and @paixaomp for the pull requests in this release, and @BurrHM, @rajarshikhatua, @oovaa, @jamorenom, @AbdullahHouso, @MatharuG, @joaogks, @edmooredop, @itszux, @dCo3lh0, @joseddg92, @traerin, @lucasew, @survey-sudo, @Clascheurduturfu, @dkess, @pratyush-1327, @pedronora, @devrimyz, @tizoras, @paganotoni, @Halliday202, @v1cferr, @mustafarec, @Yoryoboy, @Isllanrx, @Raposoraptor and @CorgiLeo for their reports.

name: ZapFast v0.19.0
body:
ZapFast 0.19.0 holds several WhatsApp numbers in one window: click your own photo to switch between them or add another. It also speaks Turkish and Traditional Chinese, opens chats with Cmd or Ctrl and a number, and fixes a window that shrank each time it reopened, a crash when renaming a group on Windows, a warning about older messages that kept coming back, and files that could not be dropped on the window on Wayland.

**Download ZapFast:** [Mac](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.19.0/zapfast-v0.19.0-macos-universal.dmg) · [Windows](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.19.0/zapfast-v0.19.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Windows ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.19.0/zapfast-v0.19.0-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Linux](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.19.0/zapfast-v0.19.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Linux ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.19.0/zapfast-v0.19.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [AppImage](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.19.0/zapfast-0.19.0-x86_64.AppImage) · [AppImage ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.19.0/zapfast-0.19.0-aarch64.AppImage) · [Flatpak](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.19.0/zapfast-v0.19.0-x86_64.flatpak) · [Debian/Ubuntu](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.19.0/zapfast_0.19.0_amd64.deb) · [Fedora](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.19.0/zapfast-0.19.0-1.x86_64.rpm)

On a Mac, `brew install --cask crmne/tap/zapfast`. On Arch, `yay -S zapfast-bin`.

![The account menu under your own photo, with two numbers and Add account](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.19.0/zapfast-0.19.0-accounts.png)

*The screenshot uses ZapFast's built-in demo content.*

## New

- **Several WhatsApp numbers in one window.** Click your own photo at the top of the chat list: a menu lists your numbers, each with its unread chats, and **Add account** links another one. Each number keeps its own chats, archive, media and keys. A dot on your photo says another number has unread chats. Your existing number moves into the new layout by itself the first time 0.19.0 starts. By @vxavierr, with the switcher reworked by @crmne. (#334, #22)
- **Turkish and Traditional Chinese.** ZapFast follows your system's language, or the one chosen in Settings. Turkish by @brsbrkctn (#341), Traditional Chinese by @a-lang (#350).
- **Open a chat with Cmd or Ctrl and a number.** Cmd+1 through Cmd+9 on a Mac, Ctrl+1 through Ctrl+9 elsewhere, open the chat in that place of the list you see, following pins, search and the chosen filter. By @moleh1307. (#345)
- **The chat list scrolls to the top when you send a message**, so the chat you just wrote to, now first in the list, stays in view. By @pulgueta. (#360)
- **ZapFast starts in the tray at login even before the panel is ready.** Started at login before the desktop's panel, ZapFast could lose its tray icon; it now shows the icon once the panel appears. On a Mac, a start at login puts ZapFast in the menu bar without bringing it to the front. By @crmne.

## Fixed

- **The window keeps its size.** With the zoom set to something other than 100%, the window came back a little smaller every time it reopened from the tray, until it was tiny. By @crmne; thanks @AlfElFriki, @xodotLBO and @jbouhier. (#293)
- **No crash when renaming a group on Windows.** Clicking the pencil to rename a group or a label closed ZapFast when Windows' accessibility features were listening. By @crmne; thanks @Adxa1. (#313)
- **The "older messages" warning only appears when you asked for them.** Opening a short chat asked the phone for earlier messages on its own, and a phone with nothing more to send showed the warning on most chats. It now shows only when you scroll to the top and the phone does not answer, and a chat whose beginning ZapFast already has is not asked again. By @crmne; thanks @rumorconsumerr. (#325)
- **Names with several words stay whole.** Renaming a contact split a first name like "Maria Clara" at its first space, and group members could show only part of their first name. By @crmne; thanks @fedalc. (#314)
- **Files drop on the window on Wayland, and paste works on Hyprland.** Dropping files on ZapFast did nothing on Wayland, and an earlier attempt to fix it stopped pasting on Hyprland. Both work now. By @crmne; thanks @felipemartoni. (#178)
- **A clicked notification brings ZapFast forward on Wayland.** The chat opened at the message, but the window stayed minimized or behind. By @Nullpntr1337. (#353)
- **Closing the window on a MacBook with a Touch Bar.** The closed window could stay on screen, frozen, while ZapFast kept running. By @crmne; thanks @victorarocha. (#260)
- **ZapFast should start on older Windows graphics drivers**, such as those of older Intel chips, and says why in a message box when the driver offers no usable OpenGL at all, instead of closing without a word. By @crmne; thanks @rajarshikhatua. (#349)
- **ZapFast's System font follows your Linux desktop's interface font.** By @crmne.
- **Scrolling with a touchpad on Wayland no longer flings the list** when your fingers rest on the pad before lifting, and Shift turns a touchpad scroll sideways at the usual speed. By @crmne.
- **The scroll bar stays off the chat filter chips.** By @n3ndor. (#355)

## Known limitations

- The Touch Bar fix has not been confirmed on a MacBook with a Touch Bar yet.
- The account menu is not in the collapsed chat list; widen the list to switch numbers.
- If ZapFast cannot move your existing number into the new layout on its first start (for example, because the system keyring is locked), it stops before opening a window and says why only in its log. Nothing is moved or lost; unlock the keyring and start it again.
- Going back to an older ZapFast after 0.19.0 starts it with an empty setup in the old place. Starting 0.19.0 again then refuses until one of the two is moved away.

## Thanks

@vxavierr, @brsbrkctn, @a-lang, @moleh1307, @pulgueta, @Nullpntr1337, @n3ndor, @iclems, @eternalwaitt and @LisandroNahuelH for the pull requests in this release, and @AlfElFriki, @xodotLBO, @jbouhier, @Adxa1, @rumorconsumerr, @fedalc, @felipemartoni, @victorarocha and @rajarshikhatua for their reports.

name: ZapFast v0.18.2
body:
ZapFast 0.18.2 finishes the new logo: the login, lock, About and Settings screens now show the icon itself, and Linux trays that showed a blank placeholder show it too. It also stops a startup burst of sticker downloads that got accounts rate-limited, so pictures and stickers sent right after connecting no longer fail, and keeps the emoji picker's Recent row still while you use it.

**Download ZapFast:** [Mac](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.2/zapfast-v0.18.2-macos-universal.dmg) · [Windows](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.2/zapfast-v0.18.2-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Windows ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.2/zapfast-v0.18.2-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Linux](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.2/zapfast-v0.18.2-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Linux ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.2/zapfast-v0.18.2-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [AppImage](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.2/zapfast-0.18.2-x86_64.AppImage) · [AppImage ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.2/zapfast-0.18.2-aarch64.AppImage) · [Flatpak](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.2/zapfast-v0.18.2-x86_64.flatpak) · [Debian/Ubuntu](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.2/zapfast_0.18.2_amd64.deb) · [Fedora](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.2/zapfast-0.18.2-1.x86_64.rpm)

On a Mac, `brew install --cask crmne/tap/zapfast`. On Arch, `yay -S zapfast-bin`.

![The linking screen with the new ZapFast icon](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.2/zapfast-0.18.2-logo.png)

*The screenshot uses ZapFast's built-in demo content.*

## Fixed

- **The new icon everywhere in the app.** The login, lock, About and Settings screens drew a flat disc in the theme's colour instead of the refreshed icon. They now show the icon itself. By @crmne.
- **The Linux tray shows the icon, not a placeholder.** Trays that look icons up by name showed an image-missing placeholder, because ZapFast sent only a picture. It now also names its installed icon. By @crmne; thanks @kalligator, who traced it. (#310)
- **Pictures and stickers send right after connecting.** ZapFast fetched every missing favourite sticker at once when it connected, and every recent one when the picker opened; WhatsApp answered with "rate-overlimit" and briefly refused the next picture or sticker too. Stickers are now fetched a few at a time, all of them pause when WhatsApp says to slow down, and a sticker gone from WhatsApp's servers is not asked for again on every start. By @crmne; thanks @claudiocp and @oovaa, whose logs pinned it down. (#298, #307)
- **The emoji picker's Recent row stays put while you use it**, so you can send the same emoji several times in a row, as in WhatsApp. It catches up the next time the picker opens. By @crmne; thanks @fedalc. (#294)
- **No crash when a sound ends after the app that started ZapFast has closed.** ZapFast could quit when a notification sound finished if it had been started from an app that was gone by then. By @dadofsambonzuki. (#297)
- **Selecting message text is steadier.** By @nathanbzrr. (#304)

## Known limitations

- Favourite stickers that were already missing now arrive over a few minutes instead of all at once.
- A portable copy run without installing its icon still depends on the tray drawing the picture ZapFast sends.
- Links that do nothing when clicked on Windows (#311) are not fixed yet.

## Thanks

@dadofsambonzuki and @nathanbzrr for the pull requests in this release, and @kalligator, @claudiocp, @oovaa and @fedalc for their reports.

![A video playing over the whole window](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.1/zapfast-0.18-expanded-video.png)

![Two messages selected by dragging, with the Forward button](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.1/zapfast-0.18-drag-selection.png)

![Drafts shown in the chat list](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.1/zapfast-0.18-drafts.png)

![The new logo on the linking screen](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.1/zapfast-0.18-new-logo.png)

![ZapFast following a Catppuccin Omarchy theme](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.18.1/zapfast-0.18-omarchy-theme.png)

*The film and all screenshots use ZapFast's built-in demo content.*

## New

- **Lock ZapFast with a password.** **Settings → Privacy → App lock** sets a password of at least six characters. ZapFast then starts locked and locks again after 1 minute, 15 minutes or 1 hour without input, also while it sits in the tray. `Ctrl+Shift+L` and **Lock ZapFast** in the tray lock it at once. Locked, the window shows only the lock screen, notifications say only "New message", and nothing is marked read. It keeps people at your computer out of your chats; it encrypts nothing more than the archive already is. A forgotten password means unlinking this computer. By @crmne; thanks @sreeaksharas. (#201)
- **Videos open over the whole window.** The expand button on a playing video, or a double-click, fills the window with it. `Esc` goes back to the message, `Space` pauses and the arrows seek. The picture and the sound carry on without a gap when it opens and closes, and videos are larger in their message too. By @crmne.
- **Your system's font and emoji.** ZapFast draws text in your platform's interface font (San Francisco on macOS, Segoe UI on Windows, your desktop's font on Linux) and emoji as your other apps draw them, everywhere: messages, text fields, menus and tooltips. **Settings → Appearance → Font** goes back to Inter. By @crmne, following the pull requests of @pulgueta (#229) and @thisisgm (#279).
- **Select several messages by dragging.** Drag down the space beside the bubbles and every message you pass joins the selection; holding the pointer at the top or bottom scrolls. Once you are selecting, a click anywhere on a message's row adds or removes it. A drag over a message's text still selects the text. By @crmne; thanks @itszux. (#246, #241)
- **Drafts show in the chat list.** A chat with unsent text shows **Draft:** and the text, as in WhatsApp. By @crmne; thanks @itszux. (#245)
- **Walk search results with the keyboard.** In a chat's search, `↑` and `↓` move through the results and `Enter` jumps to one. By @eternalwaitt. (#282)
- **Copy image from a message's menu.** A downloaded picture can be copied without opening its preview. By @crmne; thanks @edmooredop. (#272)
- **ZapFast as an AppImage.** Each release now includes `zapfast-X.Y.Z-x86_64.AppImage` and `zapfast-X.Y.Z-aarch64.AppImage`: one file, make it executable and run it, no installation. By @crmne.
- **A refreshed logo.** The teal disc gains a rim and a lit face, and the bubble is drawn in ink. The Mac icon is the same mark on a dark rounded tile. By @crmne.
- **View-once messages say what they are.** A view-once photo, video or voice message shows as "opens only on your phone" instead of a download that fails. By @crmne; thanks @ProgramGeek02. (#289)
- **Meta AI answers show up.** Replies from Meta AI appear as text, with code and tables. Earlier replies were never kept, so only new ones show. By @crmne; thanks @Star-knight-code. (#253)
- **Channels show their pictures** instead of initials. By @crmne; thanks @itszux. (#243)
- **Last seen says the day and the time**, as the phone does: "last seen yesterday at 12:04". By @crmne; thanks @fedalc. (#263)
- **Smaller touches:**
  - A right-click opens a message's menu from the empty space beside it too (@itszux, #240).
  - A click on the conversation's empty space puts the cursor back in the message box (@eternalwaitt, #283).
  - Delivery ticks are two ticks of equal height, as on the phone (@itszux, #249).
  - A picture without a caption shows its time over its corner, and **Forwarded** sits at the start of its bubble, closer to the message (@itszux, #251, #250).
  - Settings sit in the middle of a wide window (@itszux, #242).
  - The chat list ends in a line and a soft shadow, like the header, and the two headers line up.
  - Suggestion lists, staged attachments, reaction pills and the buttons that float over messages lift off the chat like bubbles.
  - The Windows taskbar badge counts unread chats, as WhatsApp does, not messages (@caumeira, #287).
  - Mentions are named in quotes, notifications and search results in groups that hide phone numbers.

## Fixed

- **Videos you send arrive with a preview.** They went out without a thumbnail, size or length, so phones showed no preview and ZapFast showed its own copy as a file to open elsewhere. Videos sent before this now play from the file on your computer. By @crmne.
- **Reactions and reads from your phone are no longer lost after a long time offline.** A reaction or a read that arrived before its message was dropped; they now wait for it. A chat your phone shows as unread no longer looks read. By @crmne; thanks @fgrehm. (#276)
- **Links keep their brackets.** `https://example.com/page_(more)` opened without its last part. By @crmne; thanks @tizoras. (#273)
- **Pasting copied files pastes the files.** Copying a PDF in the file manager and pasting it sent the file's icon as a picture. By @crmne; thanks @sdbruder. (#285)
- **The shortcuts dialog fits the window.** It had grown taller than the default window. It now takes two columns in a wide window and scrolls in a short one. By @crmne.
- **A trackpad scroll stays with the pane it began over** instead of moving the chat list when the pointer drifts onto it. By @crmne; thanks @Siddhj2206. (#274)
- **The chat list's edge can be dragged back from its widest.** By @crmne; thanks @itszux. (#239)
- **Open log does something on every desktop.** On Hyprland it could start an editor without a terminal and show nothing; it now opens the log, or shows it in its folder, or says where it is. By @crmne; thanks @fgrehm. (#278)
- **Group members show their whole saved first name**, so "My Dih" is no longer "My". By @crmne; thanks @fedalc. (#237)
- **Replying to an old message keeps your place** in the chat instead of jumping to the newest message. By @eternalwaitt. (#280)
- **Deleting a message after switching chats deletes it in its own chat.** By @tobymarks. (#275)
- **Start over works with a damaged archive key.** Once the unreadable archive is moved aside, an empty or malformed key is replaced instead of failing again. By @OmarGonD. (#266)
- **Simplified Chinese beside a Traditional region is respected.** `zh-Hans-TW` and `zh-Hans-HK` no longer fall back to English. By @LisandroNahuelH. (#254)
- **Selecting message text no longer drops while the chat scrolls.** By @yaoxinghuo. (#258)
- **One-line Arabic and Hebrew text is cut at its end**, not in the middle, when it does not fit. By @crmne; thanks @BruceUK. (#72)
- **Windows says when Credential Manager is full** instead of "error code 8" when linking cannot save its key. By @crmne; thanks @ColorfulCookie. (#257)
- **The log names why connecting failed**, and why a video's sound did not open, without private details. By @crmne; thanks @ExQueueSee and @joaogks. (#271, #265)
- **The tests pass on desktops with Noto's Arabic fonts**, which the AUR build checks. By @crmne; thanks @kevinbsr. (#259)

## Known limitations

- There is no 0.18.0 download: its macOS build could not create the disk image on GitHub's runner, so it was never published, and 0.18.1 is the same release with that fixed.

- The AppImage bundles no libraries: it needs glibc 2.39 or newer and your desktop's own libraries, like the DEB and RPM. It does not update itself; download the new file when ZapFast says a release is out. Running it needs FUSE, or `--appimage-extract-and-run`.
- The app lock is a screen lock, not encryption: it does not protect the files on your disk beyond what the archive already does.
- The new icons, the macOS menu-bar icon and the font setting were built and tested on Linux only, and sending a video with its preview was not tried against a real chat before this release. Please report anything that looks wrong on macOS or Windows.
- A video whose sound ZapFast cannot decode, such as HE-AAC, still plays silently (#265), and #271 stays open until someone confirms what the log now says.
- The new strings in German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and Chinese were not reviewed by native speakers.

## Thanks

@eternalwaitt, @tobymarks, @OmarGonD, @LisandroNahuelH, @yaoxinghuo and @caumeira for the pull requests in this release, @pulgueta and @thisisgm for the system font and emoji work, @itszux for a long list of careful reports, @fedalc, @fgrehm, @edmooredop, @sreeaksharas, @ProgramGeek02, @Star-knight-code, @tizoras, @sdbruder, @Siddhj2206, @kevinbsr, @ColorfulCookie, @ExQueueSee, @joaogks and @BruceUK for theirs, and everyone who tried the new look.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/compare/v0.17.0...v0.18.1

name: ZapFast v0.17.0
body:
ZapFast 0.17 has a softer new look, with bubbles that lift off the chat and carry WhatsApp's tails. The chat wallpaper now follows your theme or shows a picture of your own, and you can rename a group and change its photo where WhatsApp allows it. You can clear a chat, page through one with the keyboard, zoom a previewed image around the pointer, and pick stickers people sent you. ZapFast now speaks Simplified Chinese and shows unread messages on the Windows taskbar. It also fixes a Linux crash after a day of notifications, linking on networks with broken IPv6, and windows that bounced between Windows monitors of different scale.

**Download ZapFast:** [Mac](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-v0.17.0-macos-universal.dmg) · [Windows](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-v0.17.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Windows ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-v0.17.0-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Linux](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-v0.17.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Linux ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-v0.17.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Flatpak](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-v0.17.0-x86_64.flatpak) · [Debian/Ubuntu](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast_0.17.0_amd64.deb) · [Fedora](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-0.17.0-1.x86_64.rpm)

On a Mac, `brew install --cask crmne/tap/zapfast`. On Arch, `yay -S zapfast-bin`.

![ZapFast 0.17 in the dark theme: bubbles with soft shadows and tails, the raised chat list highlight and composer](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-0.17-new-look-dark.png)

![The same chat in the light theme](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-0.17-new-look-light.png)

![ZapFast following a Catppuccin Omarchy theme, with the wallpaper in the theme's colour](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-0.17-omarchy-theme-wallpaper.png)

![A picture of your own as the chat wallpaper](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-0.17-custom-wallpaper.png)

![The group dialog with the pencil to rename the group](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.17.0/zapfast-0.17-group-info-edit.png)

*All screenshots use ZapFast's built-in demo content.*

## New

- **A softer new look.** Message bubbles and date chips lift off the wallpaper with a soft shadow, and the first message of a run gets WhatsApp's tail. The chat list is one surface with rounded highlights, the composer and the reply, edit and voice strips sit raised on the chat, and the reply strip now rests right on the composer. It works the same in light and dark themes. By @crmne.
- **The wallpaper follows your theme.** A new **Theme** colour, now the default in light and dark, paints the chat in your theme's own chat colour, so a custom or Omarchy theme no longer sits on WhatsApp's beige or black. It changes with the theme at once, and the doodles adjust to stay visible. If you had kept the old default beige or black, you get Theme once; any other colour you chose stays. By @crmne.
- **Use your own picture as the wallpaper.** **Settings → Appearance → Wallpaper → Choose image…** fills the chat with a picture of your choice, in light and dark mode, and **Remove image** goes back to the colour. ZapFast keeps its own copy, scaled down when it is very large, so the original can move. By @crmne.
- **Rename a group and change its photo.** The group dialog has a pencil beside the name and a menu on the photo to change or remove it. They appear only when WhatsApp lets you edit the group's info, and a name changes only once WhatsApp accepts it. By @crmne.
- **Clear a chat.** **Clear chat** in the menu at the top of a chat empties it on this computer and on your phone after asking, and keeps the chat in your list. By @LisandroNahuelH; thanks @sreeaksharas for asking. (#224, #200)
- **Zoom a previewed image around the pointer.** Over the picture, the wheel (or Ctrl+wheel and a pinch) zooms where you point, a zoomed picture can be dragged, and a double-click switches between fit and full size. By @joaodutra88. (#218, #217)
- **Stickers people send you.** A **Received** tab in the sticker picker lists the stickers others sent you, newest first and without duplicates, so you can reuse or favourite one without scrolling back to it. **Recent** still holds only the stickers you sent. By @joaodutra88. (#214, #213)
- **Move through a chat with the keyboard.** `PgUp` and `PgDn` scroll the open chat by about a page, `Home` goes to the top of what is loaded and `End` to the newest message. By @pulgueta. (#228)
- **Unread messages on the Windows taskbar.** The unread count shows as a badge on ZapFast's taskbar button, as it already did on the Linux launcher. By @caumeira. (#235)
- **ZapFast speaks Simplified Chinese.** It is picked automatically for Chinese in Simplified script, or from **Settings → Appearance → Language**. Traditional Chinese systems stay in English rather than show the wrong script. By @LisandroNahuelH. (#233)
- **Themes are easier to make and have more contrast.** **How to make a theme**, under **Open themes folder**, opens a new [guide](https://zapfast.rocks/themes/) to the theme format and every colour. The bundled palettes are now written into your themes folder once as ordinary files to read or change, a deleted one stays deleted, and the picker lists them without `.json`. The chat, its bubbles and the panels now stand further apart, and an Omarchy template you never changed is upgraded to the new colours on the next start. By @crmne.
- **A change of theme opens from the middle of the window**, as Omarchy does it, instead of switching at once. By @crmne.
- **Deleting a message asks first.** **Delete for me** and **Delete for everyone** confirm and say what happens, as WhatsApp does. By @tobymarks. (#206)
- **A source build gets a launcher entry.** `packaging/install-user.sh` installs the binary, the icon and a desktop entry for your user, so a build from source shows up in your application menu. By @alitura1. (#222)
- **Smaller touches:**
  - The settings gear and your profile picture close Settings when clicked again (@LisandroNahuelH, #231).
  - Typing dots move at your display's frame rate instead of ten frames a second.
  - Typed text sits centred on the composer's buttons at fractional scales such as 133%, and starts closer to the emoji button.
  - Rows in the chat list touch, so there is no dead gap between chats to click.
  - Screen readers name buttons such as **Open themes folder** and the wallpaper row, and the drop-downs in Settings scroll into view when `Tab` reaches them.

## Fixed

- **ZapFast no longer crashes on Linux after a day of notifications.** Each notification waiting for a click held some resources, and KDE Plasma does not always say when one is gone (for example during Do Not Disturb), so ZapFast eventually ran out and quit. At most 32 notifications now wait; older ones stay on your desktop but no longer open their chat when clicked. By @jzadir. (#238)
- **ZapFast links on networks with broken IPv6.** When WhatsApp's IPv6 address does not answer, as on some hotspots, VPNs and routers, ZapFast now tries IPv4 instead of retrying IPv6 forever. By @LisandroNahuelH; thanks @edmooredop for the precise report. (#226, #212)
- **Downloaded files stay when a message arrives twice.** A redelivered message or a history replay no longer makes a downloaded file ask to be downloaded again. By @LisandroNahuelH. (#205)
- **Dragging the window between Windows monitors of different scale works.** It no longer bounces back to the first monitor and grows each time. By @crmne, with the winit fix by @LunaticGhoulPiano (rust-windowing/winit#4694); thanks @caumeira, whose #216 found the same cause.
- **Arabic on Windows is drawn in Segoe UI.** Windows could pick a print face that drew Arabic at about two thirds the size of the text around it. By @crmne; thanks @BruceUK. (#72)
- **Updating a copy still named FastsApp works.** On Windows the installer keeps a `fastsapp.exe` for older updaters until ZapFast starts under its own name, and installations under the old name move onto ZapFast's as they update. By @crmne.

## Known limitations

- Renaming a group and changing its photo, the Windows taskbar badge, and the Arabic font change on Windows are covered by tests but have not yet been tried by the maintainer on a real group or a Windows machine. Please report anything that looks wrong. #72 stays open until someone confirms Arabic looks right on Windows.
- On Linux, a notification older than the 32 most recent no longer opens its chat when clicked, and reading that chat no longer dismisses it.

## Thanks

@joaodutra88, @LisandroNahuelH, @pulgueta, @caumeira, @tobymarks, @alitura1 and @jzadir for the pull requests in this release, @LunaticGhoulPiano for the winit fix, @edmooredop, @sreeaksharas and @BruceUK for their reports, and everyone who reported problems and tried the new look.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/compare/v0.16.5...v0.17.0

name: ZapFast v0.16.5
body:
ZapFast 0.16.5 brings the macOS menu bar back. In 0.16.4 it stopped responding, so Settings, Cmd+, the zoom shortcuts, New Chat, Quit and the Edit shortcuts did nothing on a Mac.

**Download ZapFast:** [Mac](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.5/zapfast-v0.16.5-macos-universal.dmg) · [Windows](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.5/zapfast-v0.16.5-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Windows ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.5/zapfast-v0.16.5-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Linux](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.5/zapfast-v0.16.5-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Linux ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.5/zapfast-v0.16.5-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Flatpak](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.5/zapfast-v0.16.5-x86_64.flatpak) · [Debian/Ubuntu](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.5/zapfast_0.16.5_amd64.deb) · [Fedora](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.5/zapfast-0.16.5-1.x86_64.rpm)

## Fixed

- **The macOS menu bar works again.** In 0.16.4 the new tray took over the menu's events, so every item in ZapFast's menu bar did nothing: Settings… and Cmd+, (the ways into Settings on a Mac), zoom, New Chat, Close, Quit, Find, and the Edit shortcuts such as Cmd+C and Cmd+V. The menu answers again, and a new test on macOS keeps it that way. By @crmne; thanks @pedrozimmermannsoares for the detailed report. (#215)

## Changed

- **Updates can move to a backed-up signing key.** Release downloads are still signed with the same key, and this version also trusts a second key kept in an offline backup, so a later release can switch keys without anyone having to reinstall. Nothing changes for you now. By @crmne.

name: ZapFast v0.16.4
body:
ZapFast 0.16.4 connects and notifies right away when it starts hidden in the tray, draws text as sharply as the rest of your desktop at fractional scales such as 133%, and trims Settings down to the choices that matter. It also moves onto fastframe, the shared foundation ZapFast now shares with Spotifast, RekordFlash and TonePush, which brings a few small fixes of its own.

**Download ZapFast:** [Mac](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.4/zapfast-v0.16.4-macos-universal.dmg) · [Windows](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.4/zapfast-v0.16.4-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Windows ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.4/zapfast-v0.16.4-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Linux](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.4/zapfast-v0.16.4-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Linux ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.4/zapfast-v0.16.4-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Flatpak](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.4/zapfast-v0.16.4-x86_64.flatpak) · [Debian/Ubuntu](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.4/zapfast_0.16.4_amd64.deb) · [Fedora](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.4/zapfast-0.16.4-1.x86_64.rpm)

On a Mac, `brew install --cask crmne/tap/zapfast`. On Arch, `yay -S zapfast-bin`.

![A conversation at 133% display scale, with sharp text in the message bubbles and the chat list](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.4/zapfast-0.16.4-crisp-text.png)

*A conversation at 133% display scale (demo content).*

![The new Settings page in the dark theme, with the Appearance and Chats sections](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.4/zapfast-0.16.4-settings.png)

*The leaner Settings page.*

## Fixed

- **Starting hidden in the tray connects right away.** With "keep running" on and ZapFast set to start hidden (at login, for example), it now links, opens your archive and sends notifications as soon as it starts. Before, nothing connected until you opened the window. This had been broken since starting hidden arrived in 0.16.0. By @crmne, found while reviewing @LisandroNahuelH's #185.
- **Text looks like the rest of your desktop.** At fractional scales such as 133%, message bubbles were drawn between pixels and looked soft next to the chat list; they are now as sharp as everything else. Light text in the dark theme on Linux has the same weight as GTK apps instead of looking heavier. By @crmne.
- **Hebrew, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese and other scripts sit on the line.** Words in a script ZapFast's own font lacks no longer ride above or below the Latin text around them. More scripts and symbols find an installed font (Yi, for example), macOS now finds its Chinese fonts, and a Chinese desktop gets a Chinese font for Han characters rather than a Japanese one. By @crmne, building on fixes @OnCloud125252 (crmne/spotifast#334), @kevin9327 (crmne/spotifast#314) and @AndrewMason7 (crmne/spotifast#97) contributed to Spotifast.
- **The language follows your whole list of preferred languages.** With the language on Auto, ZapFast picks the first language in your desktop's list that it has a translation for, instead of looking only at the first and falling back to English. By @crmne.
- **Windows: a left click on the tray icon always shows the window**, instead of hiding it when it was already open; the menu opens on right click. By @TnZzZHlp in Spotifast (crmne/spotifast#310), now shared through fastframe.
- **macOS: clicking the Dock icon brings back a minimized window.** By @marijnbent in Spotifast (crmne/spotifast#67), now shared through fastframe.

## Changed

- **Text follows your desktop's font settings on Linux.** ZapFast reads the hinting and antialiasing your desktop asks for, through the desktop portal or fontconfig, so a desktop set to full hinting or to no antialiasing gets it in ZapFast too, and a change applies without a restart. By @crmne.
- **A leaner Settings page.** Fewer switches, shorter text, and sections in a clearer order (Appearance, Chats, Notifications, Privacy, System, Account, Files, About). The removed options now always behave one way: labels show as chips once you have a label, sender pictures show in groups only, names from your address book always come first, and `Ctrl+B` always collapses the chat list to its column of pictures with unread badges. The two "pause music" switches are one, **Pause other media while recording or playing**, which stays off if you had turned off either. **Show shortcut hints** moved into the Keyboard shortcuts dialog, and **Also save to your phone's contacts** is now a checkbox in the new-contact dialog, starting from your earlier choice. By @crmne.
- **The update helper keeps a log.** If installing an update fails, the message names `helper.log` in the update's folder, which is worth attaching to a bug report. By @crmne.

## Known limitations

- The text changes were measured against GTK on Hyprland on Linux, at 133% and 160%. On macOS text is now drawn without hinting, as macOS itself draws it. Windows keeps the text weight it had in 0.16.3 until it has been measured the same way.
- Removed settings are not coming back as switches. If one of the fixed behaviours gets in your way, please open an issue.

## Thanks

@TnZzZHlp, @marijnbent, @OnCloud125252, @kevin9327 and @AndrewMason7, whose fixes in Spotifast now reach ZapFast through fastframe, and @jdubba1, whose local palettes and live Omarchy themes (crmne/spotifast#392) are now the shared theme code. @LisandroNahuelH for #185, whose review turned up the start-hidden bug. And everyone reporting problems as they find them.

name: ZapFast v0.16.3
body:
ZapFast 0.16.3 stops the window from freezing on Hyprland when something covers it, fixes a crash on macOS when clicking the tray icon or closing the window, and sends forwarded messages in the order you picked them. It also adds WhatsApp's Ctrl+Shift+[ and ] to switch chats, contact cards you can chat with or add, and a way to copy an image from its preview.

**Download ZapFast:** [Mac](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.3/zapfast-v0.16.3-macos-universal.dmg) · [Windows](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.3/zapfast-v0.16.3-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Windows ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.3/zapfast-v0.16.3-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Linux](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.3/zapfast-v0.16.3-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Linux ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.3/zapfast-v0.16.3-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Flatpak](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.3/zapfast-v0.16.3-x86_64.flatpak) · [Debian/Ubuntu](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.3/zapfast_0.16.3_amd64.deb) · [Fedora](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.3/zapfast-0.16.3-1.x86_64.rpm)

On a Mac, `brew install --cask crmne/tap/zapfast`. On Arch, `yay -S zapfast-bin`.

![A shared contact card with the contact's name and Chat and Add buttons](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.3/zapfast-0.16.3-shared-contact.png)

![The image preview with its Copy image (Ctrl+C) button](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.3/zapfast-0.16.3-copy-image.png)

## New

- **Shared contacts you can act on.** A contact card shows the contact's name, and when the card names a WhatsApp account, **Chat** opens a conversation with them and **Add** saves them to your contacts. A card with only a local number shows the number. By @fabiomotta0311. (#176)
- **Copy an image from its preview.** The preview has a copy button, a right-click menu with **Copy image**, **Save as…** and **Open in another app**, and `Ctrl+C` (`Cmd+C` on macOS) copies the picture to the clipboard. By @edesiogab. (#198)
- **`Ctrl+Shift+[` and `Ctrl+Shift+]` switch chats**, as in WhatsApp's desktop app, alongside `Alt+↑/↓`. By @pulgueta. (#196)

## Fixed

- **The window no longer freezes on Hyprland.** When another window went fullscreen or maximized over ZapFast, when it started on a hidden workspace, or with the display off, Hyprland stopped sending it frames, ZapFast waited for one that never came, and Hyprland offered to close it as not responding. ZapFast now paces its drawing by the compositor and keeps working while covered. The fix is in the egui and winit versions ZapFast shares with Spotifast, and is proposed upstream as emilk/egui#8631 and rust-windowing/winit#4709. By @crmne; thanks @fgrehm for the report. (#190)
- **No more crash on macOS when clicking the tray icon or closing the window** with "keep running" on. An error raised inside macOS while ZapFast ran in the background ended the app; macOS's own event handling now catches it and ZapFast carries on. By @crmne; thanks @victorarocha for the detailed crash report. (#199)
- **Forwarded messages arrive in order.** Forwarding several messages now sends them one at a time, so a heavy attachment is no longer overtaken by the text after it, and messages that never started when the connection drops are marked failed instead of waiting forever. By @LisandroNahuelH. (#193)

## Known limitations

- The macOS fix was confirmed by forcing the same kind of error in a test build, not by reproducing the reporter's exact click. If ZapFast still quits on a tray click, please comment on #199 with what Console.app logs for zapfast.
- The freeze fix was tested on Hyprland. Other Wayland desktops that stop sending frames to covered windows should benefit the same way, but have not been tried.

## Thanks

@fgrehm and @victorarocha for the reports, @fabiomotta0311, @edesiogab, @pulgueta and @LisandroNahuelH for their pull requests (and @LisandroNahuelH again for making the right-to-left text test pass on every platform, #195), and everyone reporting problems as they find them.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/compare/v0.16.2...v0.16.3

name: ZapFast v0.16.1
body:
ZapFast 0.16.1 fixes the problems people found in the first day of 0.16: group chats that stayed empty until someone wrote, chats that shook when opened, a message box that jumped while typing, a link that went quiet after the computer slept, and files dropped on a Wayland desktop that never arrived. The composer and the voice recorder also sit better in the new rounded field.

**Download ZapFast:** [Mac](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.1/zapfast-v0.16.1-macos-universal.dmg) · [Windows](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.1/zapfast-v0.16.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Windows ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.1/zapfast-v0.16.1-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe) · [Linux](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.1/zapfast-v0.16.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Linux ARM](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.1/zapfast-v0.16.1-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz) · [Flatpak](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.1/zapfast-v0.16.1-x86_64.flatpak) · [Debian/Ubuntu](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.1/zapfast_0.16.1_amd64.deb) · [Fedora](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.1/zapfast-0.16.1-1.x86_64.rpm)
