![The composer with the plus and emoji buttons seated in its rounded end](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.1/zapfast-0.16.1-composer.png)

![Recording a voice message: discard, the time, and the waveform across the field](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast/releases/download/v0.16.1/zapfast-0.16.1-recorder.png)

## Fixed

- **Group chats show their messages when opened.** While ZapFast recovered the phone's chat lock state, it held back the first read of the open chat and never answered it, so the chat stayed empty (search still found the messages) until someone wrote. By @crmne; thanks @Adxa1 for the report and @leandroruel for looking into it. (#180, #181)
- **Chats no longer shake when opened.** A picture whose message didn't state its size took one height on screen and another off it, and a chat held at its last message could bounce between the two every frame. By @crmne; thanks @Adxa1. (#179)
- **The message box stays still while you type.** When a line wrapped or joined, the box grew a frame late and briefly hung below the window. By @crmne.
- **ZapFast reconnects after sleep.** After the computer wakes, or when the connection has received nothing for two minutes, ZapFast reconnects and fetches what arrived meanwhile, instead of waiting on a connection that looks open but no longer delivers. The underlying hang is also proposed upstream as oxidezap/whatsapp-rust#1547. By @crmne; thanks @edmooredop for the detailed report. (#177)
- **Dropping files works on Wayland.** Files dragged from a file manager onto ZapFast in a Wayland session now attach, as they already did under X11. By @crmne; thanks @felipemartoni for tracking down the cause. (#178)
- **The composer's buttons sit in its rounded ends.** Plus sits in the left end like send in the right, emoji sits close beside it, and the send button no longer has an uneven gap around it. By @crmne.
- **The voice recorder uses the whole field.** Discard, the time, and a waveform across the field, then send, as in WhatsApp, instead of everything squeezed against send. By @crmne.

## Thanks

@Adxa1, @leandroruel, @edmooredop, @felipemartoni, and everyone who tried 0.16 on its first day and told us what broke.

body:

Photos and videos open and play inside the app, stickers get favorites synced with your phone, packs, search, and a sticker maker, and a side pane searches any chat by day. The composer is rounded with a plus menu, Settings has a search field, and ZapFast now speaks six more languages. Favorites, labels, unread marks, account privacy, and leaving groups all work from the desktop, most of them synced with your phone. ## New

- **Photos and videos open inside ZapFast.** Images open in a preview with one zoom control. By @fabiomotta0311 (images) and @crmne (video); thanks @AlfElFriki. (#115, #62)
- **Stickers, redone.** The picker has tabs for Recent, Favorites, and each pack, plus search by emoji or pack name. By @LisandroNahuelH, @fabiomotta0311, and @crmne; thanks @Leoglez10 and @Adxa1. (#170, #149, #166, #159)
- **See who read your messages.** **Message info** lists who read, who has it delivered, and who played a voice message, for groups and one-to-one chats. By @crmne.

By @LisandroNahuelH, @fabiomotta0311, and @crmne; thanks @ImFenyx and @letruxux. (#160, #154, #164, #136, #18)
- **Join and leave groups from the desktop.** Invite links open a preview with **Join**, and **Leave group** or **Leave channel** can archive the chat in the same step. By @crmne and @LisandroNahuelH; thanks @Adxa1. (#64, #169)

- **ZapFast speaks your language.** The interface follows your system's language, with Brazilian Portuguese, German, Spanish, Italian, French, and Russian available, and **Settings → Appearance → Language** picks another. By @fabiomotta0311 and @crmne. (#141)
- **Notifications that make sense.** A message sound for every chat, a mention sound when a group @mentions or replies to you, a switch to keep ordinary group messages quiet, and a sound per chat, using Pidgin's classic sounds by default. Clicking a notification opens the exact message. By @crmne and @fabiomotta0311; thanks @lopezcelani. (#130, #167)
- **Voice messages.** Other apps' music pauses while you record or play a voice message or a video and resumes afterwards (Linux and Windows). Consecutive voice messages play one after another, and 1.25x and 1.75x join the speeds. By @crmne and @fabiomotta0311. (#168, #120)
- **Live locations** show as a map card that updates, and a live location your phone shares with this computer as a placeholder says to follow it on the phone. By @fabiomotta0311 and @crmne. (#143)
- **Connect through a proxy.** **Settings → Network → Proxy** takes `socks5h://`, `socks5://`, or `http://`, and an empty field follows `ALL_PROXY` or `HTTPS_PROXY`. By @crmne; thanks @aandrew-me. (#12)
- **Interactive messages** from businesses show their cards and buttons, and quick replies can be answered. By @rafaelsantana6. (#113)
- **Chat wallpapers** in WhatsApp's colours, with ZapFast's own doodles. By @leandroruel and @crmne. (#137)
- **Forward several messages at once**, selecting them with `Ctrl`-click and `Shift`-click. By @crmne; thanks @xodotLBO. (#46)
- **Save attachments where you choose**, with **Save as…** and a download folder in Settings. By @crmne; thanks @idanyashar, @birdbox219, and @danalec. (#57, #66, #68, #98)
- **Start in the tray at login.** By @crmne; thanks @pedronora. (#109)
- **Collapse the chat list to avatars**, with unread badges, when you hide it. By @fabiomotta0311. (#151)
- **Smaller touches:**
  - Drafts are kept in the encrypted archive (@fabiomotta0311, #148).
  - A divider marks where unread messages begin (thanks @Adxa1, #82).
  - React and Reply buttons appear on hover (@fabiomotta0311, #116).
  - `Arrow Up` edits your last message (@fabiomotta0311, #123).
  - The clock follows your system's 12-hour or 24-hour setting (@fabiomotta0311, #124).
  - The unread count shows on the Linux launcher badge (@Nullpntr1337, #156).
  - Skin-tone emoji appear in the composer's suggestions (@Nullpntr1337, #158).
  - Your own chat is easy to find as "(You)".
  - WhatsApp Plus accounts can pin 20 chats (thanks @fgrehm, #39).

## Fixed

- **Chats load again after updating.** 0.15.0 could wait forever for your phone's chat lock state and never show a chat. By @crmne; thanks @Adxa1, @ricardorfaria1, @dlhnx, and @bslakmon. (#128, #155)
- **Hebrew and Arabic read correctly**, with emoji in the line, the caret moving the right way, and Arabic as large as the Latin text around it. By @shinycake and @crmne; thanks @BruceUK. (#144, #73, #72)
- **Long chats stay light.** Only the messages on screen are laid out, so a chat with thousands of messages no longer slows every frame or keeps growing in memory. By @folkwayse. (#174, #146, #145)
- **Read receipts no longer stay at one tick.** Receipts that arrived before their message were dropped. By @crmne; thanks @letruxux. (#31)
- **Replies never go out without their quote.** When the original can't be quoted, nothing is sent and your text, attachments, or voice message come back. By @udaya2899, @leandroruel, and @crmne. (#27, #134)
- **Channels muted on your phone stay quiet here**, and archived chats stay archived when history arrives. By @crmne; thanks @osama-dev2206 and @BenjiMandel. (#79, #35)
- **Your phone gets notifications while ZapFast is open**: ZapFast only shows you online while you use it. By @crmne; thanks @givemeworld1. (#119)
- **Stickers and GIFs stop flickering** and placeholders settle. By @fabiomotta0311 and @crmne; thanks @Leoglez10. (#140, #165)
- **WAV and other audio phones can't play are sent as documents.** By @crmne; thanks @joaogks. (#162)
- **A window restored off-screen comes back**, and launching ZapFast again brings a minimized window forward. By @fabiomotta0311 and @crmne. (#171)
- **Only you can talk to your running ZapFast.** The channel a second launch uses is now private to your user. By @crmne; thanks @princesaini. (#80)
- **macOS updates start from inside the signed app.** By @tobymarks. (#129)
- **When the archive key is gone, ZapFast offers to start over** instead of getting stuck. By @crmne; thanks @eyademb7-eng. (#83)
- **Messages that open only on the phone say so**, including view-once media. By @crmne; thanks @letruxux. (#30)
- **Opening files no longer leaves zombie processes on Linux.** By @crmne; thanks @dakai. (#132)
- **The typing indicator uses far less CPU**, and times and counters no longer shift as their digits change. By @tassiovirginio and @crmne, with Spotifast's steady digits from @hyperpuncher. (#127)

## Known limitations

- **macOS: updating from 0.15.0 or earlier inside the app fails** with "The update helper exited before it was ready". Install 0.16.0 from the DMG once; updates from 0.16.0 onward work.
- Pausing other apps' music isn't available on macOS, which has no public way to do it.

name: ZapFast 0.15.0: Easier chats, clearer controls
body:
0.15.0 makes everyday conversations easier to navigate, with chat filters, a full emoji reaction picker, and faster voice-message playback. It also brings clearer controls, safer updates, and fixes for chat deletion, group names, and attachment handling.

## New

- **Find the conversations you want.** Filter the chat list by unread messages, private chats, or groups, with unread counts beside the filters. By @rafaelsantana6 and @crmne. (#71)
- **React with any emoji.** Open the full picker from the reaction menu, search for an emoji, and keep frequently used reactions close at hand. By @shinycake and @crmne. (#37)
- **Listen to voice messages at your pace.** Switch between 1x, 1.5x, and 2x from the player. By @gustavobragac. (#41)
- **Reply with a double-click.** Double-click a bubble's empty space to reply; double-clicking message text still selects a word. By @rafaelsantana6 and @crmne. (#70)
- **Choose a Rosé Pine palette.** Rosé Pine, Moon, and Dawn join the theme choices, alongside automatic Omarchy theme following. By @ThatOneCalculator. (#74)
- **Navigate with clearer keyboard focus and accessibility labels.** Buttons, fields, switches, and messages expose their names and state to accessibility tools. Tab navigation highlights the focused control. By @tobymarks and @crmne. (#106, #87)
- **Build and install with Nix.** A flake provides development and package builds for both Linux architectures. By @0xsharkboy; thanks @NnannaOmoke for the request. (#108, #111, #34)

### Reactions, filters, and voice playback

![The full emoji reaction picker beside a synthetic conversation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/zapfast/v0.15.0/docs/release-media/0.15.0/reactions.png)

![Rosé Pine with chat filters and voice-message speed controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/zapfast/v0.15.0/docs/release-media/0.15.0/rose-pine.png)

## Fixed

- **Arabic replies keep their words in the right order.** Ligature-shaped text no longer bypasses the word-order correction in messages, quoted replies, or the composer preview. By @crmne; thanks @MaXShadeR for the exact example. (#126)
- **Deleting a chat on your phone removes it here too.** Clear-chat changes also sync, delayed history does not restore deleted messages, and messages newer than the deletion are preserved. A chat-menu action lets you delete older stale chats. By @tobymarks and @crmne; reported by @tobymarks and verified in live testing by @crmne. (#97, #61)
- **Locked chats stay private across sync and restarts.** Phone lock changes hide conversations from the ordinary list, search, and notifications. A local code opens the locked folder, which is currently read-only. By @FelipeMayerDev and @crmne. (#55)
- **Group names survive incomplete metadata.** Empty responses no longer erase known titles, and unresolved names retry with backoff. Quoted sender labels also refresh when a contact name becomes known. By @fabiomotta0311 and @crmne; thanks @sdbruder for reporting missing group names. (#114, #81)
- **Attachments fail clearly instead of spinning indefinitely.** Downloads enforce a 64 MiB limit, use verified staging files, and stop after two minutes with an inline retry error. The Download action is disabled while a request is active. By @Crisiszzz07 and @crmne. (#85)
- **Pasting a browser image no longer adds its source URL.** By @crmne; thanks @akitaonrails for the report. (#84)
- **Errors and controls are easier to understand.** Failed sends say “Not sent”; actionable errors stay until dismissed; toast text and buttons align; incomplete phone-number actions are disabled. Delivery timestamps are informational, with a separate Copy message ID action. Switches show their state by shape as well as colour, and built-in themes have stronger text contrast. By @tobymarks and @crmne. (#99, #100, #101, #102, #104, #105)
- **The desktop does less work while idle.** Fixes reduce unnecessary redraws and Wayland layout failures. Animated media stays on its first frame until hovered in a focused window. By @ucmz851, @MrVoicer, and @crmne; thanks @SeanPedersen for the idle-CPU report. (#33, #29, #20)
- **Archived chats stay quiet, and windows fit screen zones.** Archived conversations no longer trigger desktop notifications; the window can snap and resize into smaller spaces. By @fabiomotta0311. (#117, #122)
- **Pairing and text display are more reliable.** WhatsApp Business pairing uses the updated protocol library; Brazilian phone numbers format correctly; macOS uses the bundled colour emoji font. By @leandroruel, @tobymarks, and @crmne. (#112, #69)
- **Updates require a trusted signature.** Release checksums are authenticated before an update is accepted, the TLS dependency is updated, and pairing credentials are kept out of shipped logs. By @Crisiszzz07 and @crmne; thanks @enrell and @princesaini for security reports. (#44, #80, #103)

### Matching the desktop

Omarchy theme following remains available through Settings. This preview uses a synthetic Catppuccin desktop palette.

![Settings following a synthetic Omarchy palette](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/zapfast/v0.15.0/docs/release-media/0.15.0/omarchy.png)

All screenshots use offline demo conversations, not personal chats.

## Known limitations

Older attachments can remain unavailable even after retrying or asking the phone to upload them again. A retry is not a guarantee of recovery. Polls show vote totals and your own selection, not voter names or avatars. Accessibility labels are tested automatically, but screen-reader behaviour still needs broader platform testing. The signature-enforcing app must itself be installed through a trusted source; older clients gain this protection only after upgrading.

## Thanks

name: ZapFast 0.14.0: Polls, themes, and a quieter desktop
body:
0.14.0 brings polls, encrypted local archives, and themes that follow your desktop. It also reduces unnecessary background work and fixes everyday annoyances on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

**Make ZapFast feel at home on Omarchy.** Choose Follow system and let the app use your desktop palette, including when you change themes. These offline demo previews show the same settings in dark and light Omarchy palettes.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1be30818-0569-4bb1-977f-184eb3f8f83b

| Catppuccin | Catppuccin Latte |
| --- | --- |
| ![ZapFast following a dark Omarchy palette](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/zapfast/main/docs/release-media/0.14.0/omarchy-dark.png) | ![ZapFast following a light Omarchy palette](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/zapfast/main/docs/release-media/0.14.0/omarchy-light.png) |

## New

- **Create and vote in polls.** Use the checklist beside the attachment button to ask a question with single or multiple answers. Vote in the chat, change your selection, or click a selected answer to withdraw it. Earlier results are requested automatically from your phone. By @crmne.
- **Make the app match your desktop.** Choose Light, Dark, Follow system, or a local JSON palette. Catppuccin, Catppuccin Latte, Nord, Ristretto, and Tokyo Night are included. On Linux, Follow system follows Omarchy and reacts to theme changes without restarting. Ported by @crmne from the Spotifast theme work by @jdubba1 and @crmne.
- **Keep the local message archive encrypted.** Messages, contacts, and sticker metadata now use SQLCipher, with automatic unlocking through your OS keyring. Existing archives migrate automatically. Cached attachments remain ordinary files. By @crmne; thanks @HalanoSiblee for the report. (#4)
- **Install verified updates from inside the app.** Supported direct installations can download checksum-verified updates, then restart when you choose. A failed installation can restore the previous copy. Package-managed installations continue to use their package manager. Ported by @crmne from Spotifast's updater work by @coah80 and @crmne.
- **See which chats have disappearing messages enabled.** A timer badge appears beside the chat picture. Outgoing and forwarded messages honor the destination chat's timer. By @fgrehm and @crmne. (#7, #15)
- **Get back to writing with a shortcut.** Ctrl+L, or ⌘L on Mac, focuses the message input. The × on the left of the shortcut hints hides the bar; restore it in Settings. By @crmne.
- **Install through your preferred package manager.** Updated AUR packages, DEB/RPM packages for both Linux architectures, a Flatpak bundle, and a Homebrew cask accompany this release. On Mac: `brew install --cask crmne/tap/zapfast`. By @crmne; thanks @olumolu for the Flatpak request. (#3)

**Ask the group, then vote right in the conversation.** All content below is synthetic demo data.

| Create a poll | Vote and see results |
| --- | --- |
| ![Creating a single-choice poll in ZapFast](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/zapfast/main/docs/release-media/0.14.0/create-poll.png) | ![Poll options and vote counts in a group conversation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/zapfast/main/docs/release-media/0.14.0/polls.png) |

## Fixed

- **Idle windows do less unnecessary work.** Offscreen animations and history synchronization no longer drive continuous repaints, and Linux theme changes use filesystem notifications. Recovery from repeated app-state conflicts has also improved. By @crmne; thanks @fuuumornin and @nojaf. (#5, #9)
- **Windows loads inline images, profile pictures, and stickers correctly.** Fixed the Windows file paths passed to the image loader. By @crmne; thanks @letruxux. (#17)
- **Windows notifications come from ZapFast, with compact sender pictures.** Notifications no longer identify PowerShell as their source or use the avatar as a large inline image. By @crmne; thanks @letruxux. (#19)
- **macOS no longer asks where to find `use_default`.** Notifications use ZapFast's application identity without opening the application chooser. By @crmne.
- **Hebrew words keep their order in names and conversations.** Improved message bodies, previews, and quoted replies, while preserving logical copied text. By @shinycake and @crmne; thanks @idanyashar. (#2, #14)
- **Pinned chats keep their order as new messages arrive.** Phone mute settings and pin changes survive history replay, and existing archives request a one-time settings refresh. Search ignores accents, and Escape dismisses the current action before closing the conversation. By @crmne; thanks @AlfElFriki. (#13)
- **Local application directories are private on Unix.** Existing directory permissions are repaired, and startup stops if the directories cannot be prepared safely. By @fgrehm and @crmne. (#11)
- **Your own linked devices do not appear as someone typing.** Direct and group chats now follow WhatsApp's behavior. By @crmne.

A few limits remain: earlier poll totals depend on history supplied by your phone, and complete historical results are not yet confirmed in every case. Connected-session CPU usage still needs confirmation from reporters, including @SeanPedersen in #20. Poll creation in disappearing-message chats remains unsupported, and Hebrew support is not yet a complete bidirectional-text implementation. The downloadable Flatpak bundle is available now; Flathub submission remains separate. Linux builds require glibc 2.39 or newer and a working Secret Service keyring for archive encryption.

## Thanks

@fgrehm and @shinycake for their contributions; @jdubba1 and @coah80 for the Spotifast work reused here; and @HalanoSiblee, @fuuumornin, @nojaf, @AlfElFriki, @idanyashar, @letruxux, @olumolu, @SeanPedersen, and everyone who reported problems and helped test these changes.

body:
FastsApp is now **ZapFast**, with a new home at [zapfast.rocks](https://zapfast.rocks). This release also brings signed and notarized macOS downloads.

## New

- **ZapFast throughout the app:** the executable, window, tray, notifications, installers, and newly linked devices use the new name. The GitHub project is now [crmne/zapfast](https://github.com/crmne/zapfast).
- **Signed and notarized macOS app:** the universal DMG is signed with Developer ID, accepted by Apple's notarization service, and includes a validated notarization ticket.

## Upgrading

- Your settings, linked session, message archive, saved stickers, caches, and window state move automatically from FastsApp or the earlier fastwhatsapp name. Existing ZapFast data is preserved.
- Quit FastsApp before starting ZapFast. If the old client is still running, launching ZapFast brings its window forward so the session is not used by two clients.
- On macOS, install ZapFast in Applications, then remove the old FastsApp application bundle.
- Use `zapfast` to launch a source installation. Existing linked devices may keep the old name on your phone until you link again; relinking is not needed to keep using the app.

FastsApp 0.12.1 fixes unread badges, notification cleanup, and unexpected read receipts when using your phone and linked computers together.

## Fixed

- **Unread state syncs even with blue ticks off.** Reading a chat in FastsApp now tells your other linked devices that it was read, independently of the read-receipt preference. Reads made offline are saved and retried when the connection returns.
- **Fewer stale unread badges.** Replies sent from your phone clear preceding unread messages. Delayed history and read receipts no longer bring cleared badges back or clear newer messages by mistake.
- **A hidden window stays unread.** Closing FastsApp to the tray or switching away no longer lets stale window focus automatically read messages in the last open chat.
- **Read-receipt preferences also cover voice messages.** The toggle now controls played receipts, and direct chats check current WhatsApp account privacy before sending read or played receipts.
- **Linux notifications follow chat reads.** Reading a chat here or on another device dismisses its outstanding desktop notifications, including notifications still being delivered.

Thanks to Andrea for reporting the unread-count and read-receipt inconsistencies.

Download the update from the assets below or the [download page](https://fastsapp.rocks/download/). `checksums.txt` lists SHA-256 checksums for all release files.

name: v0.9.0
body:
![FastsApp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/fastsapp/main/docs/screenshot.png)

FastsApp is a native WhatsApp client written in Rust with egui: one small binary that starts in a blink, sips memory, and feels like WhatsApp Web without a browser wrapped around it. It speaks the WhatsApp Web protocol through [whatsapp-rust](https://github.com/oxidezap/whatsapp-rust), messages stay end-to-end encrypted on your computer, and your history lives in a local SQLite archive that is yours. If this is the first release you are seeing, welcome; the guide lives at [fastsapp.rocks](https://fastsapp.rocks).

## Sticker packs, in one paste

The sticker tab grew a doorway. **Find packs** opens the [signalstickers.org](https://signalstickers.org) gallery and its thousands of free packs; copy any pack's link there, and the pack imports the moment the link lands in the field. A `.wastickers` file from any WhatsApp sticker site works through **Open file**. Animated packs keep their motion: their APNG frames are converted to animated WebP, the form WhatsApp plays, so they move for the people you send them to. In the picker, a moving sticker plays while your pointer rests on it.

Beyond packs, any sticker that passes through a chat can be kept with a right-click, and the kept ones live in a Saved row. Everything is stored as plain WebP files in a folder of yours; a pack leaves through the little bin beside its name.

## A message tells its journey

Right-click a message and it says when it was sent, delivered, and read, each with its moment, in the same menu as everything else. No separate info screen to visit. Hovering a reaction names who gave it, so two hearts under a group message are no longer anonymous.

## Typing, the way the phone shows it

Someone typing appears as three rising dots beside their picture, and when several people type at once their pictures half-stack the way the phone draws them. The header says "Mira is typing" with the verb where it belongs.

## And the rest

- The GIF search now explains itself when GIPHY refuses a key: the error, a link to developers.giphy.com, and a field to paste your own, right there in the picker (thanks @andpsc for the report, #1).
- A contact's or group's card shows a bigger photo and follows the window: shrink the window and the card shrinks with it instead of overflowing.
- Settings say plainly when your WhatsApp account's own privacy keeps read receipts off, fetched from the account when FastsApp connects.
- The picker's tabs sit centred and stay at the panel's bottom edge.
- Animated stickers no longer leave traces of their earlier frames behind while playing: FastsApp now decodes animated WebP through libwebp itself.

## Install

| Platform | Asset |
| --- | --- |
| Arch Linux | [`fastsapp-bin`](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/fastsapp-bin) or [`fastsapp`](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/fastsapp) on the AUR |
| Linux | `fastsapp-v0.9.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` (arm64 beside it) |
| macOS | `fastsapp-v0.9.0-macos-universal.dmg` (one image for Apple Silicon and Intel) |
| Windows | `fastsapp-v0.9.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-setup.exe` (arm64 beside it) |

`checksums.txt` carries the SHA-256 of every file. First start shows a QR code: on the phone, **Linked devices**, **Link a device**, point the camera. History replays once, then everything arrives live, and the phone does not need to stay on the same network.

## The honest part

FastsApp is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. Using an unofficial client may be against WhatsApp's terms of service and could get an account suspended. Use it at your own risk.
